claim_boundary: lyrical-repertoire proximity between source-labelled corpus slices only; not a real-world rapper relationship, identity, affiliation, style, genre, or audio-performance claim

model.embedding: BGE-M3 clean-text embeddings; no audio, beat, voice, or Flow input
model.representation: comparison-population exact-clean-text duplicate-controlled lyric chunk centroids by source artist label
model.sensitivity: remove exact clean text that occurs under more than one source artist label
model.spatial_projection: deterministic 2D PCA of normalized consensus primary-plus-sensitivity lyric-repertoire centroids across all graph-eligible labels; distance is an approximate semantic display and does not define edges
